north_star.rule: Every row and pitch proposal names this objective; src/stages/rows.mjs reads it from here as OBJECTIVE. The number's target, deadline and weekly ladder live in docs/NORTH_STAR.md, never a copy here; targets below keep the 5/1 registry lock.

recognition.counts_when: the show or stage confirms a date

intensity.rule: At U3 and above, on a week with no signed spec in force, src/stages/intensity.mjs raises each volume cap named here to the top of its bound below; a signed spec keeps the caps he set. Volume only: no wall, send, spend, fit floor or authority moves.

bounds.rule: The week spec sets each cap inside these bounds (src/crew/compile.mjs); at U3 and above with no signed spec, the intensity block above lifts its volume caps to their max (Ruling, Krish, 2026-10-29). A value outside one is refused, never clamped; no spec can change a bound, and none carries send or spend authority. direction says which way is the safer move from today's value.
